Interface Repository<T,ID>

Type Parameters:
T - type of objects stored in the Repository.
ID - type of the <ID> used to index objects in the Repository.
public interface Repository<T,ID>
Public interface of system a component that stores objects of type <T> (or of sub-type <S>) indexed by an id of type <ID>.

"1.0.0-SNAPSHOT"
